mutations.sql: create or replace function public.purge_connection_vendor_rows(p_connection_id uuid) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$ declare v integer; begin delete from public.revenue_records r using public.publishes p where p.id = r.publish_id and p.platform_connection_id = p_connection_id; get diagnostics v = row_count; delete from public.youtube_report_jobs where platform_connection_id = p_connection_id; update public.publishes set metadata = coalesce(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) - 'sync', duration_seconds = null where platform_connection_id = p_connection_id; return jsonb_build_object('revenue_records_api', v, 'youtube_report_jobs', 1, 'publishes_reset', 1); end; $$;
